transport: Real Cookie, HTTP and PostgreSQL in the production-dist browser harness

observations.observed: POST context on path demo-c32-project with projectRevisionRef other-project@1 returned HTTP 200 and demo-c32-project@1, rather than rejecting the mismatched entity.

The C34 registered source returned conversion, segments and cleaning at pageSize=50. At pageSize=1 it returned conversion only and no nextCursor. Passing an arbitrary cursor returned the same conversion again with HTTP 200. Assertions verified the missing continuation and identical first/next stages.

ingestion for demo-c32-series-settlement@nonexistent-version returned HTTP 200 with the real monitoring batch and snapshot instead of rejecting the invalid exact target. This proves version mismatch; cross-spatial exploitation remains a static audit finding, not a runtime claim.

memberships query returned HTTP 200 and a membership-revision UUID version. Sending that exact membershipRef as expectedVersion with the unchanged current roles, status and spatial refs returned HTTP 409 STALE_VERSION. There was no intervening membership update.

Using the same operator browser session and restricted source B, a valid evidence-access query returned HTTP 404 NOT_FOUND, while workspace ingestion returned HTTP 200, source-segment-set segment-set-demo-browser-segments-b@1 and segmentCount=2. Assertions verified the differing access decisions. This is processing-reference/count disclosure; no source body disclosure is claimed.
